items.question: What counts as the last activity for the 14-day no-submissions rule when a task has submissions?
items.ticket: Tasks with no submissions for 14 days are flagged
items.chose: Measures staleness from the latest submission's timestamp, and falls back to the posting time only when there are no submissions.
items.instead: Flag only tasks with zero submissions that are 14 or more days old, or measure from the posting time.

items.question: Is a task exactly 14 days without activity flagged?
items.ticket: Tasks with no submissions for 14 days are flagged
items.chose: Flags the task when the idle time is greater than or equal to 14×24 hours.
items.instead: Flag only when the idle time is strictly more than 14 days.

items.question: Which tasks count as open?
items.ticket: Digest is skipped when nothing is open
items.chose: Treats a task as open only when its status is exactly "open", so every other status is excluded.
items.instead: Treat any non-terminal status as open, for example by excluding only merged or closed tasks.

items.question: What does buildDigest return when nothing is open?
items.ticket: Digest is skipped when nothing is open
items.chose: Returns null for an empty list or when no task has status open.
items.instead: Return an empty digest object, or throw.

items.question: In what order are tasks listed?
items.chose: Sorts stalled tasks first, then oldest posting first, then by id in code-unit order.
items.instead: Keep the input order, or sort by age descending only, or by id.

items.question: What does the email subject say?
items.chose: Builds the subject as "Weekly digest: N open tasks, M stalled", with no singular form and no date.
items.instead: Use a fixed subject such as "Weekly digest", or include the date or handle pluralization.

items.question: How is task age computed and rounded?
items.chose: Computes age as whole elapsed 24-hour periods, floored, between postedAt and now.
items.instead: Count calendar days in the organization's time zone, or round up or to the nearest day.

items.question: How is the furthest gate defined for a task with no submissions?
items.chose: Reports gate 0 when there are no submissions, and otherwise the highest gate across all submissions regardless of order.
items.instead: Use null or undefined for no gate, or take the gate of the latest submission.

items.question: On which day is the digest due, and in which time zone?
items.chose: Due when the weekday in the given time zone is Monday, at any time of that day.
items.instead: Use UTC weekdays, or fire only at a specific hour, or only once per Monday.

items.question: What happens with an unknown time zone?
items.chose: Throws an Error "Unknown time zone: <tz>", and does so even when the task list is empty.
items.instead: Fall back to UTC, or only validate when a time zone is actually needed.

items.question: Do submissions timestamped after now affect staleness?
items.chose: Includes future-dated submissions in the latest-activity calculation, so the idle time can be negative and the task is not flagged.
items.instead: Ignore submissions dated after now, or treat them as invalid.
